title: textDocument/semanticTokens/full
description: Forwarded LSP 3.17 request, typed in eludite-protocol (lsp::SemanticTokensFull, brief 0066). Params carry eluditeGeneration like every forwarded request. The answer is the whole document's tokens with a resultId the next full/delta request quotes. The host advertises semantic tokens to Roslyn with full, delta and range requests, formats [relative], no overlapping or multiline tokens and augmentsSyntaxTokens; Roslyn then uses its 'pure LSP' legend: the standard LSP token types followed by its custom names (recordClass, delegate, field, constant, extensionMethod, controlKeyword, operatorOverloaded, stringEscapeCharacter, stringVerbatim, excludedCode, punctuation, regex*, json*, xmlDocComment*) and the modifiers static, ReassignedVariable and deprecated.
